experimental_controls_and_testing_logic: Tests zero-shot transfer across carriers and terminal layouts holding New York metro airspace congestion and ~24m taxi queues constant.
Tests transferability between a 1-mile linear mega-terminal (DTW) and multi-concourse finger piers (PHL) under high schedule adherence (delays < 14m) and fortress dominance.
Evaluates Time-to-Recovery (TTR) and R_MASE behavior when severe convective thunderstorms trigger FAA Ground Delay Programs (GDPs) across the New York metroplex.
Serves as the experimental control cohort where schedule shocks are rare and fluidity is high, contrasting against extreme volatility at DFW, ORD, and EWR.

Provides n = 4 independent checkpoints per carrier and n = 2-3 airports per cluster to achieve proper degrees of freedom for Two-Way Repeated Measures ANOVA and Kruskal-Wallis non-parametric tests across Archetypes.
